query: Which statistical methods best detect run episodes in balance-sheet time series: hazard models, structural-break tests, high-frequency event studies, or jump-detection in spreads?

response.query: Which statistical methods best detect run episodes in balance-sheet time series: hazard models, structural-break tests, high-frequency event studies, or jump-detection in spreads?
response.answer: Jump-detection in spreads and structural-break tests best detect run episodes in balance-sheet time series. Hazard models and high-frequency event studies are less suitable for this purpose.

results.content: # Mueren al menos siete personas en accidente de autobús en Rusia. MOSCÚ, 3 feb (NNN-TELESUR) — Al menos siete personas fallecieron y 31 resultaron heridos en un accidente de tránsito en el oeste de Rusia. Las autoridades informaron que entre los muertos se encuentran cuatro menores de edad y tres adultos, el accidente tuvo lugar cuando un autobús se volcó en la región rusa de Kaluga, a unos 150 kilómetros al suroeste de Moscú. Desde el hospital local reseñaron que ya han recibido a parte de los afectados, que han sufrido heridas moderadas y se encuentran en estado estable. Al momento del accidente en el autobús se encontraban 48 personas, entre ellas 33 menores. Las autoridades indicaron que aún desconocen las causas del siniestro por lo que sigue bajo investigación. results.content: The State of Florida is famous for many things, including its beaches, the city of Miami (a major center of Spanish Language media and lots of crime dramas), Cape Canaveral, strip clubsnoteWanda Sykes joked that Florida has so many strip clubs, its flag should just be a brass pole, Walt Disney World, the sprawling tropical wetlands of Everglades National Park, alligators, the 2000 election, and being where many old Americans go to retire. For decades, Florida was America's quintessential swing state — its huge, diverse population drawn from throughout the country and Caribbean, wide range of community types (big cities, small towns, suburbs, rural areas, military bases — you name it, Florida's got it), and outsized importance in the electoral map (the third-largest haul of electoral votes in the country) made it the most fiercely contested swing state in the country. (not to be confused with the state of Washington)—is the national capital, created when the new government decided that it should have a capital city that was not part of any state and was centrally located in the border region between the North and South.
